# Is a QCD better than giving cash? Put your numbers in.

> Free QCD calculator: compare a qualified charitable distribution from your IRA with giving cash. See the effect on AGI, taxable Social Security, the senior deduction, federal and state tax, and what the gift really costs. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
